en.description:
MyHealth is a health and fitness tracker that keeps your health data where it belongs: on your device.

—— What you can track ——

ACTIVITY
Log walks, cycling, yoga, gardening, stairs and more from quick presets, or add your own.

WORKOUTS
Log training sessions set by set; personal records come only from what you log.

HIKES
Browse a list of Bay Area trails with their length and elevation.

DIET AND NUTRITION
Log meals and track what you are actually eating over time.

SLEEP AND MIND
Wind-down breathing sessions and a mood log. Sleep stages need Apple Health or Health Connect, which this version does not read.

VITALS
Log blood pressure, glucose, weight and body composition. Anything you have not logged shows a dash, never a made-up number.

MEDICINE
Keep track of what you take and when.

BINDER
Your records, together, instead of scattered across apps and paperwork.

—— Reading and reference ——

ARTICLES
Health and wellbeing reading inside the app.

TOOLS
Calculators and reference material for the numbers you track.

—— Real data only ——

The doctor finder searches the public CMS NPPES provider registry live, drug labels come from OpenFDA, and food lookups from Open Food Facts. MyHealth does not read Apple Health or Health Connect or track GPS in this version, so screens that would need them say so instead of showing sample numbers. Photos you take or pick (a meal, a nutrition label, a lab report, a prescription, an insurance card or your profile picture) stay on your device for your own reference; they are never uploaded and the app does not analyse them. Insurance, lab and prescription screens let you type in your own details.

—— Privacy and ads ——

Your logs live on your device and are not uploaded, even when you sign in. Crash reports and usage analytics are off unless you turn them on in Settings. Sign-in is optional — tap "Continue as guest" and everything works. The app asks for consent before it begins, and a production build carries no QA credentials.

MyHealth shows ads from Google AdMob. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure those ads. The app does not ask to track you across other companies' apps, and where the law requires consent (the EEA, the UK and Switzerland) ads are requested only after you make a choice, which you can change under Settings > Privacy choices. Your health logs are never shared with Google or advertisers.

—— Not a medical device ——

MyHealth is for general wellbeing and self-tracking. It is not a medical device, it does not diagnose or treat anything, and nothing in it is medical advice. Talk to a qualified clinician about your health, and never change a treatment because of something this app showed you.

en.release_notes:
First release of MyHealth.

• Log activity and workouts; browse Bay Area trails
• Log diet and nutrition, vitals and medicines
• A binder that keeps your records together
• Health articles and reference tools in-app
• Sign-in is optional - "Continue as guest" unlocks everything
• Your logs stay on your device
• Shows ads from Google AdMob

Screens that would need Apple Health, Health Connect or GPS say so instead of showing sample data. MyHealth is not a medical device and gives no medical advice.

Feedback: contact@americangroup.ai

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
MyHealth is a health and fitness tracker that keeps your health data where it belongs: on your device.

Intended audience:
Activity, diet, sleep, vitals

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
The app opens on a sign-in screen. An account is optional; the main features can be reached without signing in.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Firebase (Google) — app initialisation
- Firebase Crashlytics (Google) — crash reporting
- Firebase Analytics (Google) — usage analytics
- Supabase — account and data storage
- Google Sign-In — authentication
- Sign in with Apple — authentication
- HTTPS requests to the app's own endpoints
- CMS NPPES NPI Registry (public, keyless) — doctor search
- OpenFDA (public, keyless) — drug label lookup
- Open Food Facts (public, keyless) — food and barcode lookup
- Open-Meteo (public, keyless) — weather and air quality
- health.gov MyHealthfinder (public, keyless) — health topics
- Google AdMob (ads) — banner ads above the tab bar and an occasional, frequency-capped interstitial between main tabs; Google UMP consent is collected where required (EEA, UK, Switzerland) before any ad request. No App Tracking Transparency prompt: the app does not track users across other companies' apps. No health data is sent with ad requests.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app follows the device language for 12 locales (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish), but translation is partial: shared labels are translated, while most screen text is in English only. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
Account deletion is available in the app under Settings, and on the support site.
